name: ssd1306
title: SSD1306 OLED
notes: A monochrome OLED controller with 128x64 of memory; a smaller panel shows a window of it. On I2C the address is 0x3C, or 0x3D with SA0 high.

facts.source: include/drivers/ssd1306.h of DGX 0.10.11: SPI or I2C, contrast 0 to 255

i2c.source: esp32_c3_oled_042 on 2026-11-06: the panel answered at 0x3C and DGX drew on it at 400 kHz
